implemented: Native W/A stage geometry selects initial 2^22, S1 2^24, S2 2^22 and later cosets at most 2^23, with the same policy checked by Tree before allocations and salt reads.
Large extension commitments use four native Fp3 columns / twelve base limbs. The excluded S3 2^24 geometry is rejected.
Sourcewise residual geometry supports up to D35; above D16 the first prefix is at most seven bits. Complete source/Eq vectors are not introduced.
Blocked P/Q ceiling is 2^21. The denominator, inverse spectrum, advances and paired DFT twiddles are cached across two adaptive folds and scaling.
The second fold removes the cache before the successor commitment. New power bases invalidate old preparation before the new claim setup.
Short final blocks consume the valid prefix of the cached series. Native field bases and original MAC closure are unchanged.
Named residual storage now includes retained P/Q Vec capacities/descriptors and an upper for both twiddle payloads, explicitly not a complete physical peak.
The analytic ledger marks CPU blocked P/Q implementation present, while full-domain validation and integrated CUDA remain false.

canonical_geometry_check.execution: Configuration arithmetic only; no D34/D35 allocation, source reads or salt draws.

d17_full_chain.scope: Full reduced PCS proof, not a Gemma inference certificate or real Seed6 run.

accounting_limits: Named P/Q values include Vec capacities and descriptors, not just logical lengths.
The twiddle addition is a payload upper derived from the pinned paired-table implementation, not full DFT metadata or allocator overhead.
Transient numerator/FFT buffers, source getter, S1, masks, Merkle, verifier and Seed6 still need complete simultaneous physical accounting.
The source-uniform work bound remains conditional; this record does not transfer analytic counts to native runtime.
CPU owner destruction and Vec truncation do not prove RSS or HBM release.
